props.name: divider
props.comment: Rendered between a tab's fields, not after the last.

props.name: spacing
props.comment: The gap between a tab's fields, in units of 4px. Defaults to 4.

props.name: syncWithLocation
props.comment:
Follow the URL (default `true`): the active tab comes from the location
under the show route and a change navigates there, keeping the query
string. `false` keeps the active tab in local state.

props.name: value
props.comment: The active tab's URL segment. Overrides both modes.
